subject.title: [Bug]: Discord elevated allowFrom fallback from channels.discord.allowFrom does not work on 2026.3.22

question: Should OpenClaw restore the shipped Discord elevated fallback from `channels.discord.allowFrom`, or make explicit `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` the supported security contract going forward?
rationale: This changes who can reach elevated host exec from Discord and current main's docs correction conflicts with the latest release's documented fallback, so automation should not pick the authorization policy.

options.title: Restore plugin-owned fallback
options.body: Implement the fallback through the Discord channel/plugin adapter seam, share it with diagnostics, and cover explicit-empty override, per-agent restriction, and account-scoped behavior before merge.

options.title: Require explicit elevated allowlists
options.body: Keep the current-main contract, close or retitle the linked fix PRs, and document the release-note correction so users know to duplicate the allowlist under `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord`.

options.title: Adopt or replace the fork PR
options.body: Use the open fork PR as source work only after rebasing or replacing it into a maintainer-modifiable branch that respects the plugin boundary and preserves current diagnostics output.

recommendation.title: Restore plugin-owned fallback
recommendation.body: Implement the fallback through the Discord channel/plugin adapter seam, share it with diagnostics, and cover explicit-empty override, per-agent restriction, and account-scoped behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent docs correction and the main elevated/plugin-seam history involved in this security contract choice.
